title: Karis Nemik
description: The youngest of the rebel team stationed on Aldhani, Karis Nemik was an idealistic rebel who was willing to sacrifice his life to end the Empire. His brilliance was matched only by his burning desire to help the cause. As a gifted astro-navigator, he played a key role in the heist of the Imperial payroll, but after his death, the words of his manifesto gave Cassian Andor more reasons to fight.
